data.name: Lethal Invasion
data.detailed_description:
Lethal Invasion is a competitive online third-person game where all players face each other to achieve victory.

Each match can host up to 15 players in the same lobby. Eliminate enemies to upgrade your weapons, purchase skills, and make your way to victory using magic or your abilities (melee weapons only affect enemies, not other players).
Each time you defeat another player, you will earn 25% of their money and 25% of their score.

The first player to reach the victory score wins the match.

The game offers several modes: one for 5–10 players and another for 10–15 players.

Additionally, leveling up will earn you gold coins, which can be used to unlock new transformations and improve your skills.

WEAPONS

You can obtain weapons from Power Stones, special structures that give you a random weapon for $1000. Keep in mind that melee weapons only affect enemies, while rivals can only be damaged with magic weapons.

The chance of getting a magic weapon is much lower than getting a melee weapon, but if you’re lucky enough to get one, use it wisely! Weapons can break due to wear or be destroyed by your rivals.

Additionally, there is a special candy that can destroy all your opponents’ weapons. There is also another candy that allows you to protect your money and weapons (except your score) for a limited time.

WEAPON UPGRADES

You can upgrade your weapons to deal more damage and have greater durability. Currently, weapons have a maximum of 3 levels, although this limit may be increased in the future.

MONEY

Money can be earned by eliminating enemies and, most importantly, by defeating other rivals. Each time you defeat a player, you will receive 25% of all their money.

MAGIC

Magic is a core part of the game. With magic weapons and the transformation ability, you can directly damage your rivals. But that’s not the only way to use magic: when you activate the fists, you can launch energy balls that deal little damage but slow down enemies and rivals, helping you catch fleeing opponents or hinder those chasing you.

Additionally, you can propel yourself with magic to move much faster across the map.

SUPER ATTACK

For now, the game features a Super Attack, though more will be added in the future. This special attack can be activated when the elimination bar reaches its maximum.

Once activated, you will unleash a devastating power lasting several seconds: it deals high damage to enemies and lower damage to rivals, but if they fail to dodge it, they won’t be able to withstand it and will be defeated.

ABILITIES

The game currently has 3 abilities, with more planned for the future. These are: healing, shield, and transformation. You can upgrade them to increase their effect and strengthen yourself during matches.

It’s important to note that you must purchase abilities before using them. Each ability is single-use: once used, it is consumed, and you must buy another to use it again.

TRANSFORMATIONS

The transformation ability is unique, allowing you to become a much stronger creature with high health. In this form, you can defeat enemies and rivals more easily.

As you level up, you will unlock more powerful transformations.

SCORE

To earn points, you need to collect score tokens. These appear whenever you eliminate an enemy or defeat a rival and must be manually collected.

Be careful! Even if you made the elimination, nearby players can steal the token if they reach it first… and they can even use Candies to gain an advantage.

When you defeat a rival, the score token will grant you 25% of their total score, so try to collect it quickly before another player takes it.

CANDIES

Periodically, you can obtain two random Candies, each costing $1000. These Candies come in different rarities: Normal, Special, Epic, and Legendary.

Each Candy grants a Power Object, which can be used to damage, disrupt, or hinder enemies and rivals in various ways.

Because they are so useful, you can only carry a maximum of 2 Candies in your inventory. If your inventory is full, you cannot obtain more until you use one.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/ Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
